intro.fallback: As Shino Aburame explains to his class that within one week they'll be going through graduation examinations for genin positions, the majority of the class voices their views on the opportunity.
However, Sarada questions the meaning of a shinobi and her future, despite being told she must be proud of being born into the Uchiha Clan.

Sarada walks home, jealous that her classmates were being trained by their fathers for the exams — with Chōchō Akimichi eating with her father; Inojin Yamanaka getting drawing lessons from his father; and even Boruto...

outro.fallback: Annoyed that she is being ignored while trying to lose weight, she simply sighs as Sarada appears.
